pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
Put your hands up! (두 손을 들어!)
At this moment! (지금 이 순간!)
Are you ready?

[Verse 1]
I step back up onto the stage again
Take a deep breath under all the lights
Even if my hands are shaking, it’s okay
This time, I’m pressing play for me

[Pre-Chorus]
I was crying, now I’m laughing out loud
Can you hear my heartbeat now?
Everything is about to change

[Chorus 1]
I’m rising up again! (Hey!)
Step by step, I’m moving on! (Go!)
The piano shakes my heart inside
I scream it out and sing it loud!
I’m rising up again! (Hey!)
Now I’m the one in the spotlight!
Everybody hands up! (Bang!)
From today, it’s a brand new start!

[Post-Chorus]
Jump! Jump! Jump! This moment right now!
Jump! Jump! Jump! Just believe in me!

[Verse 2]
Yesterday’s tears have all dried up
Tomorrow’s me is waiting there
The girl in the mirror’s smiling back
Now I’m gonna learn to love myself

[Pre-Chorus 2]
Throw away all of your fears
On this stage, it’s only me
Everybody shout it out!

[Chorus 2]
I’m rising up again! (Hey!)
Now I’m flying high! (Go!)
The piano carries all my dreams
I scream it to the sky and sing!

[Call & Response Drop]
“I am!” I woke up again
“I am!” また起きた
“I am!” เธอตื่นแล้ว
나는 다시 일어났어!!!

[Bridge]
It’s okay if the tears fall down
It’s okay to smile and cry
This moment is my whole life
I will never let myself go

[Final Chorus]
I’m rising up agaaaaain!!!
Now I’m becoming the liiiight!!!
Riding the piano, I’m flying the sky
The whole world dances with me tonight!
I’m rising up agaaaaain!!!
Now I’m my everythiiing!!!
Everybody scream it out
I woke up again!!!!!

[Outro]
I woke up again!!!!!
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
